item.text: The pager stops when the returned item count is below `pageSize`. Since deleted invoices are filtered out before that count is checked, the first page looks short even though the gateway has a next cursor. I’ll make the cursor the end-of-scan signal and add the reported regression case.

Fixed invoice pagination in [pager.ts](/C:/Users/LAUTI_~1/AppData/Local/Temp/cdb-a-catalog-pages-original-4-baanesfu/ws/src/pager.ts): the scan now continues until the gateway returns a null cursor, even when deleted records make a page appear short. Added a regression case for `i-1`, deleted `i-2`, and active `i-3` in [export.test.ts](/C:/Users/LAUTI_~1/AppData/Local/Temp/cdb-a-catalog-pages-original-4-baanesfu/ws/tests/export.test.ts).

I reviewed the diff; I did not run tests.
